queries.name: GROUP BY ServiceName: time only
queries.sql: SELECT ServiceName, count() AS c FROM default.otel_logs_all30 WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY ServiceName ORDER BY c DESC
